info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Careers Applications Documents-v4-spec
info.description: The Careers Applications Documents Retrieval API allows users to access and retrieve all relevant documents associated with various career applications. This API is designed for HR professionals and hiring managers who need to review application materials such as resumes, cover letters, and other supporting documents. By utilizing this endpoint, organizations can streamline their application review process, ensure easier access to candidate information, and enhance decision-making efficiencies. Typical consumers include recruitment teams and applicant tracking system developers.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of documents associated with applications.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch all documents linked to their applications. It provides a comprehensive view of the documents along with necessary metadata, enabling users to manage their application documents effectively.
